origin: supplement-v13 (three oracles, full curves) and external-v14 (two binary frozen-encoder tasks), scaled up
brier: multiclass: mean over records of sum_k (p_k - 1[y=k])^2
noise_index: mean Gini impurity 1 - sum_k p_hat_k^2 over stream candidates

inference.method: paired t over trajectory seeds within dataset; Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided intervals and Holm within each registered family

predictions.Q1: Grid A: whole-curve test reuse = ALC(oracle-split) - ALC(oracle-test) is material positive (simultaneous lower bound > 0.0005) in at least 6/8 datasets.
predictions.Q2: Grid A: the reuse share of the test-oracle lead over the best strategy is larger in the late window than in the early window in at least 6/8 datasets.
predictions.Q3: Grid A: every strategy falls materially short of oracle-test in at least 7/8 datasets, and of oracle-exante in at most 4/8 datasets.
predictions.Q4: Grid A: early-window outcome luck = ALC(oracle-exante) - ALC(oracle-split) over steps 1-10 is material positive in at least 4/8 datasets.
predictions.Q5: Grids B and C separately: the number of datasets where every strategy falls materially short of oracle-test exceeds the number where every strategy falls materially short of oracle-exante.

scope: Frozen pretrained encoders plus retrained softmax heads (BoSS also retrains only the final layer); not end-to-end fine-tuning; 512-record test and validation samples; one PCA-64 representation per seed fitted on label-free auxiliary features; outcome model = multiclass GBDT on auxiliary labels only.
stopping: fixed seeds; no interim endpoint inspection; no seed expansion; failures retained
excluded: no biology, chemistry, drone or other domain-specific data at the user's request; only the most common public benchmarks
